Get CEBL Games

Source: R/cebl.R
cebl_games.Rd

Schedule and results of one season (regular season and finals), with the Genius match id that joins play-by-play and shots; optionally one team's games.

Endpoint: GET https://api.data.cebl.ca/games/{season}/

Usage

cebl_games(season, team_id = NULL)

Arguments

season

(required) Season: the calendar year it is played in (May to August) = the sdv END year (2025 = the 2025 season). The CEBL's first season is 2019. A season with no data answers hoopR_no_data.

team_id

(default NULL) CEBL team id (team_id in cebl_teams): limits the rows to that team; the rows echo it.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with one row per game. Its columns are listed in return_columns (subset(return_columns, fn == "cebl_games")) and in the searchable return columns article.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in cebl_seasons().

See also

Other CEBL Functions: cebl_news(), cebl_player(), cebl_player_gamelog(), cebl_player_leaders(), cebl_player_seasons(), cebl_player_stats(), cebl_roster(), cebl_seasons(), cebl_standings(), cebl_team_stats(), cebl_teams()
